lyr_meta_description: What every line of Bonito Bonito means in English — the cafecito, the sonrisita, the abracito — plus who sings it, who wrote it and how the call-and-response works.

lyr_title: Bonito Bonito lyrics in English, line by line
lyr_intro: Bonito, Bonito is a list of small nice things, sung in Spanish diminutives so every noun sounds like something you could pinch. That is the whole trick, and it is why the song works as a baby video: each line is a pose.
lyr_intro2: Below is what the lines mean in English, how the call-and-response is built, and where to find the words in full. We do not reprint the lyrics — they belong to their writer — but you do not need them to follow the dance.
lyr_facts_text: Two things surprise people: the singer is not a person, and the words were written by one. The second half of that sentence is what keeps the song on playlists rather than in a novelty folder.
lyr_structure_text: It is a call and response, announced in the first line: yo digo una, y ustedes contestan — I call one out, and you answer back. The singer names a small thing, the answer comes back with a diminutive, and the pattern repeats. Every verse has the same two-bar shape, which is why a five-second clip already feels complete and why people can join in without learning choreography.
lyr_structure_text2: That structure also explains the hand moves in the trend. The line tells you what to do with your hands: a coffee, a smile, a hug, a ray of sun. Each one is a gesture, not an abstract idea.
lyr_lines_text: These are the phrases you actually hear in the clips, what they mean, and the move that goes with each. Diminutives have no clean English equivalent — the closest we get is little — so the translations lean on little and nice.
lyr_meaning_heading: What the song is actually saying
lyr_meaning_text: Strip the cuteness and it is a short argument: happiness is not loud, it hides in small things, and a small step still counts. The middle section says it plainly — no hace falta tener más, hace falta mirar mejor — you do not need to have more, you need to look better. The last lines add the one social note: y cuando se comparte, se siente más bonita, and when it is shared it feels even nicer.
lyr_meaning_text2: That is why the audio fits family videos and does not feel like a novelty track. It is a song about looking after ordinary days, which is exactly what a clip of your own baby doing a silly dance is.
lyr_copyright_heading: Where to read the full lyrics
lyr_copyright_text: The official lyric video and the licensed lyric services carry the complete text. We deliberately do not reprint it here: the song is under copyright, and a page that copies it reads worse and ranks worse. What this page gives you is the meaning, which is what most people searching for Bonito Bonito lyrics in English actually want.
lyr_menino_text: In Brazil the same trend is searched as menino bonito, menino bonito AI — Portuguese for pretty boy, close to how the Spanish hook sounds. It is the same song, not a Portuguese version. If that is how you found this page, you are in the right place.
lyr_use_heading: Using this audio in a baby video
lyr_use_text: The trend works because the original clip is already cut to the song: 12 seconds, the full routine, the audio baked in. You upload one photo of your baby, the routine and the song are kept frame-accurate, and only the baby is replaced. The 5-second cut uses the hands-on-cheeks, hands-on-hips section, which is the part most people recognise.
lyr_use_text2: You do not need the lyrics for this and you do not need a template. The song comes from the reference clip, so what you post is the audio everyone already knows.
lyr_faq1_q: Is Bonito, Bonito in Spanish or Portuguese?
lyr_faq1_a: Spanish. The hook sounds like menino bonito to Portuguese speakers, which is why Brazilian searches use that spelling, but the song is Spanish and the performer is credited as Thiago Navarro Music.
lyr_faq2_q: What does un cafecito riquito mean?
lyr_faq2_a: A nice little coffee. Cafecito is a small coffee, riquito means nice and tasty. It is the first line of the call-and-response and the one people mime with a sip.
lyr_faq3_a: Anier Cruz Revilla is credited as writer and composer. He also built the performer, Thiago Navarro, with AI tools — the words are his, the voice is not.
lyr_faq4_q: Can I use the song in my own video?
lyr_faq4_a: For a personal post the normal platform rules apply, and the sound is available as a licensed audio on TikTok and Instagram. For anything commercial, ask the rights holder: a paid video generator does not grant you music rights.
isai_meta_title: Is Bonito Bonito AI? Yes — Here Is Which Parts
isai_meta_description: Bonito Bonito is an AI song performed by an AI persona called Thiago Navarro. The lyrics are human. The evidence, the timeline, and what that means for the baby video trend.
isai_nav_desc: The singer does not exist. The songwriter does. Evidence and timeline.
isai_title: Is Bonito, Bonito AI? Yes — and here is exactly which parts
isai_intro: Short answer: the performer is an AI persona, the voice and melody were generated, and the lyrics were written by a person. The song is credited to Thiago Navarro Music, a name that does not belong to a singer you could book.
isai_split_heading: The short answer, in one table
isai_split_text: People usually mean one of two things by is it AI. Here is both, separated, because the answer is different for each.
isai_evidence_text: Three public signals line up. Spotify labels the Thiago Navarro profile as an AI Persona. YouTube marks the official video as created with AI. And the songwriter has said so himself, describing how he writes the lyrics and then uses several tools for the melody, the voice and the character's face. El Tiempo in Colombia and El Comercio in Ecuador reported the same in September and October 2026.
isai_evidence_text2: That matters for a boring reason: it is checkable. You do not have to take a blog's word for it — the platform labels and the writer's own statement are one click away.
isai_timeline_text: Two months, in five lines. The song came first, the dance trend came from Latin America, and the English-language baby template arrived last, which is why the same audio suddenly appears in feeds that never played the original.
isai_rio_heading: The Río Roma version is a different thing
isai_rio_text: Río Roma, the Mexican duo, released their own Bonito, Bonito video on 21 October 2026. That is a human performance of the song, and it is not the audio in the baby trend. So no — not every version is AI. The original Thiago Navarro release is the AI one; a cover by real singers is still a cover.
isai_video_heading: So is the baby video AI too?
isai_video_text: Yes, and we say so on the page. What you upload is one photo of your baby. A video model replaces the baby in the original clip with that photo, frame by frame, and the original song is laid back on top. Nothing about your child is invented — the face is yours, the dance belongs to the reference clip.
isai_video_text2: That is the honest description of what every generator in this niche does, the CapCut template included. The differences are where the routine comes from, what resolution you get back, and whether the file arrives with a watermark.
isai_faq1_q: Is Thiago Navarro a real person?
isai_faq1_a: No. Thiago Navarro is a virtual artist created with AI tools by songwriter Anier Cruz Revilla. There are no concerts, no in-person interviews, and no human voice on the record.
isai_faq2_q: Is the song AI, or only the singer?
isai_faq2_a: Both the voice and the melody were generated with AI. The lyrics were written by a person, which is the part the songwriter keeps emphasising.
isai_faq3_a: Yes, credited to Thiago Navarro Music and tagged by Spotify as an AI Persona. El Tiempo reported roughly 1.5 million monthly listeners by late September 2026.
isai_faq4_q: Does that make the baby videos fake?
isai_faq4_a: They are synthetic video of a real child's face, made from a real photo. Whether that counts as fake is your call, but you should know which part is generated: the motion, not the child.
tn_meta_title: Thiago Navarro: The Virtual Artist Behind Bonito Bonito
tn_meta_description: Who is Thiago Navarro? A virtual artist built with AI by songwriter Anier Cruz Revilla, credited on Bonito Bonito and Quédate con lo sencillo. Facts and sources.
tn_nav_desc: A virtual artist, not a singer. The songwriter, the releases, the labels.
tn_title: Thiago Navarro is not a singer. He is a character.
tn_intro: The profile calls him an artista digital, and that is the accurate description. Thiago Navarro Music is the name on the release; behind it is a songwriter who writes the lyrics himself and uses AI for the voice, the melody and the face.
tn_who_text: Anier Cruz Revilla is credited as writer and composer of Bonito, Bonito, and he built the performer. He describes writing the lyrics first, then generating the melody, the voice and the character's image with several tools — he told La FM the whole process for Bonito, Bonito took around two days. He has been careful in interviews to say the technology amplifies an idea rather than replacing performers.
tn_facts_text: Everything here is checkable from the platform pages and the press coverage, and nothing is inferred from a comment section.
tn_concert_heading: There is no tour, and there will not be one
tn_concert_text: The most common disappointment in the comments is that nobody can see him live. That is not a scheduling problem — there is no performer to book. The appeal of the setup is speed: an idea can become a released, finished song without a studio, a session singer or a video shoot.
tn_earlier_text: Cruz Revilla was already releasing music: he is credited on CubaniPro, a catalogue of songs about Cuba and Cubans living abroad, with releases from February 2025. Under the Thiago Navarro name the first song was Quédate con lo sencillo, a more romantic track that found a smaller audience. Bonito, Bonito was the one that travelled.
tn_trend_heading: Why a baby video trend grew out of it
tn_trend_text: The song is built for imitation: a call, a response, a gesture per line, eight lines, twelve seconds. That shape is exactly what a short video needs, and it is why the audio survived the trip from a Latin American dance trend into an English-language baby template. Nobody has to learn the steps — you copy the clip.
tn_trend_text2: Our tool leans on that: the routine, the camera move and the song come from the original clip, and only the baby changes.
tn_faq1_a: Anier Cruz Revilla, a songwriter credited as writer and composer on Bonito, Bonito. He created the persona and the voice with AI tools.
tn_faq2_q: Where is Anier Cruz Revilla from?
tn_faq2_a: Coverage is not consistent — El Tiempo and several outlets describe him as Cuban, some Spanish-language reports call him Venezuelan. What every source agrees on is that he is the credited writer and the person who built the character.
tn_faq3_q: Does Thiago Navarro have other songs?
tn_faq3_a: Yes. Quédate con lo sencillo came before Bonito, Bonito, and the catalogue is released under Thiago Navarro Music.
tn_faq4_q: Why does the name sound like a real Latin singer?
tn_faq4_a: Because that is the design. A plausible name and a plausible face get shared; the labels are what tell you it is a persona. Spotify's AI Persona tag and YouTube's created with AI note are the two places to check.
nc_meta_title: Bonito Bonito Baby Video Without CapCut (No Watermark)
nc_meta_description: How to make the Bonito Bonito baby dance video without the CapCut template: your own photo, the original song, a 720p MP4 with no watermark. What the template cannot do.
nc_nav_desc: What the template cannot do, and the three-step route around it.
nc_intro: The CapCut template is free and it works. It also has three fixed habits: it picks the baby for you, it stamps the app on the export, and it lives inside an app. If you want your own child, a clean file and a 12-second cut, you need a different route.
nc_limits_text: None of this is a flaw — a template is a fixed edit with a photo slot, and it is honest about being one. It just means the decisions were made before you arrived.
nc_compare_text: Same trend, same song. The difference is who controls the face, the length and the file.
nc_how_text: Upload one photo: face forward, even light, no sunglasses. Pick 5 seconds — free with the sign-up credits — or 12 seconds. Download the MP4 when it finishes; the render takes a couple of minutes, not an afternoon of keyframes.
nc_how_text2: Because you are not editing, there is nothing to get wrong: no track to align, no mask to animate, no frame where the face slips.
nc_quality_text: 720 by 1280 vertical, 30 fps, the original song, 5 or 12 seconds. The swap keeps the baby's position, pose, head direction and mouth movement from the clip, and takes the clothes from your photo. A soft or heavily filtered photo is the usual reason a render looks off — start with a sharp one.
nc_quality_text2: If a render fails, the credits come back. That is the one advantage a paid tool has over a free template: there is a refund path.
nc_when_heading: When CapCut is the better answer
nc_when_text: If you want a free video for a private group chat and the template's baby is fine, use the template. Paying only makes sense when the face has to be your own child's, the file has to be clean, or the video is going somewhere a watermark cannot go.
nc_faq1_q: Do I need CapCut at all?
nc_faq1_a: No. You need one photo and a browser. The song comes from the reference clip rather than a sound library, so nothing has to be imported.
nc_faq2_a: No. You get the MP4 at 720 by 1280 with the original audio and no badge.
nc_faq3_q: Can I make it on a phone?
nc_faq3_a: Yes. The upload takes a photo straight from the camera roll and the finished file downloads to the phone.
nc_faq4_q: What if the face does not match?
nc_faq4_a: Re-run with a sharper photo. Every render is checked against the photo automatically, and when the check fails the job is refunded instead of delivered.
